inventory.saleNotEditableHint: This sale can't be edited — either its shift is closed, or you don't have permission to edit sales.
inventory.saleEditHint: Changes re-price the sale. Cash must still cover the new total; card and KHQR keep only the reference.
inventory.discountNoPermHint: You need the "Apply a discount" permission to change discounts.
inventory.nameKmHint: Optional — shown when the app is in Khmer
inventory.importCategoriesHint: A CSV with columns name_en (required) and name_km. A name that already exists is skipped.
inventory.importProductsHint: A CSV with columns name_en, name_km, barcode, category_id, category, unit, type ("standard" or "service", default standard), cost, price, reorder_point, active, parent_sku, variant_name. Price is always required, and so is a category (category_id or category) — unless the row is a variant, see below. category_id (the number shown on the Categories tab) is exact and wins if given; category matches by name and is only used when category_id is blank. A service row is never stocked — reorder_point is ignored for it. To import a variant, set parent_sku to an existing product's SKU (from an earlier row or already in the catalog) plus a variant_name — name_en, category and type are then inherited automatically and don't need to be filled in. SKU is generated automatically, same as adding a product by hand.
